result_summary.title: UI alignment issues in Customer Portal (EU-Central Dev)
result_summary.description: We are seeing UI elements misaligned in the Customer Portal in the development environment in EU-Central. It's hard to tell if this is a bug in the portal's specific code or if the underlying Design System Component Library is rendering incorrectly. This is affecting 216 users in the dev sandbox with high perceived impact due to broken workflows.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the Design System Component Library configuration and update it if necessary to resolve the UI alignment issue.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The UI alignment issue in the Customer Portal is likely due to an issue with the Design System Component Library, possibly related to a product defect. The evidence from the service health and technical signals suggests that the library has experienced minor availability dips and latency spikes in the past, which could be contributing to the issue. Further investigation is needed to confirm the root cause and determine the best course of action for resolution.
